name: Indogulf Cropsciences Ltd
title: Indogulf Cropsciences Ltd - 544432 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q1 FY27 revenue fell 11% YoY to Rs 168.5 cr on monsoon-delayed demand and price pressure, while gross margin rose to 28% from 22%; management gave no numeric FY27 guidance and finance costs rose ~19%.

utilisation.quote: capacity utilization increased to 70% during the quarter compared with 52% in FY26

capex.quote: We are also continuing to invest in our manufacturing infrastructure, including the expansion at Barwasni and the development of the DF manufacturing facility.

triggers.label: Utilisation 52% → 70%
triggers.quote: capacity utilization increased to 70% during the quarter compared with 52% in FY26

triggers.label: Prices under pressure, China supply elevated
triggers.quote: Prices of several molecules remained under pressure as global supply remained elevated

triggers.label: Trade cautious, dealers not stocking
triggers.quote: Dealers and distributors remained cautious about building inventory until there was greater visibility on sowing and crop conditions.

triggers.label: No FY27 growth number given
triggers.quote: we don't want to commit for any figures

triggers.label: Captive technical use ~34%
triggers.quote: We are seeing Quarter 1 this has improved to around 34%

guidance.value: no numeric guidance; 'we don't want to commit for any figures'
guidance.quote: we don't want to commit for any figures
Yes, it should be around Rs. 1100 crores - Rs. 1200 crores, up to that.

guidance.value: Rs 1800 crore plus in approx 4-5 years

red_flags.label: Finance cost up ~19% with inventory build
red_flags.quote: We have bought the material anticipating that there will be a good sales

red_flags.label: Revenue down 11% YoY; PAT down ~38%
red_flags.quote: Profit after tax stood Rs. 2.4 crores as compared to Rs. 3.9 crores in Q1 FY26

evasions.topic: FY27 growth and ROE/PAT margin outlook
evasions.quote: It's too early to predict 5 years.
we don't want to commit for any figures
